data.body:
[P2] Establish the evidence for dropping checkpoint compatibility

Rule 6 requires evidence for external assumptions or an explicit `unverified` label. The description justifies removing compatibility with assertions that the package has never been published and no release wrote the old checkpoint types, but cites no supporting evidence and marks neither assumption unverified. This matters because moving these classes changes the registry keys used to reconstruct failures. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, document the evidence or uncertainty, and agree on the compatibility policy.
